$comment: Single source of truth for public claims. README, site and docs render from this file; tools/claimcheck.mjs fails CI when they drift.

claims.text: Rules engine: one pure hourly step shared by backtest, paper and live.
Price gate: a real fill is blocked when the pool and Chainlink differ by more than 2%, or the feed is stale.
Each hour's price closes are sealed on chain before the next hourly close.
Each hour's agent decisions are sealed on chain before the next hourly close.
A decision changed after sealing no longer matches its root.
Missed seals are shown as missed, never back-filled.
Hourly Chainlink closes for 35 Robinhood Chain stock tokens, stored as read and never rewritten.
SealRegistry deployed and source-verified on Robinhood Chain.
20 house paper agents decide every hour.
Holding 1,000,000 TAURO unlocks one slot for your own paper agent, 5,000,000 unlocks three. Balances are read on chain at every hourly run.
Burning 1,000,000 TAURO to the dead address adds one slot for 30 days. Each burn is checked on chain and listed publicly.
Anyone can sign a call on a stock token. It is sealed in the next hourly root on Robinhood Chain and scored against the Chainlink close at its horizon.
Seal bounty: 5,000,000 TAURO for the first valid way to fake a sealed record or rewrite a sealed hour, open until 31 December 2026.
One public wallet trades real money. Every real fill links to its tx and to a decision sealed before it.
Verify CLI: recompute any sealed hour from public data.
Holding TAURO raises read API limits.
